Two features stand out as the most evolutionarily significant contributions of bryophyte jasmonate biology. The first is the cis -to- iso isomerization of dn-OPDA, which constitutes a bryophyte-specific ligand activation mechanism that is chemically and enzymatically distinct from the JAR1-mediated JA activation via conjugation in vascular plants.
